He wears no sunglasses and no wristwatch. He holds his phone out toward the viewer; its screen shows his own laughing face in dark sunglasses, paused. One person. Each visible hand has a thumb and four fingers. His face and the phone in the upper half of the picture. No dog, no animals.
bk_79.setting: the open deck of a white yacht at night in our time, anchored off a small dark island in the Philippines: white rails, a videoke machine with a dark screen; no writing anywhere, no logos
bk_79.light: full moon over a calm black sea, cold blue moonlight, one dim deck lamp, richly painted, detailed ink linework, textured brushwork
